These routes of the platform API come from its [OpenAPI document](../openapi.json); [The REST API as a contract](../rest-api.md) says what Lakana promises about them.

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/search`

Search an environment

Finds tables, columns, runs, jobs, repositories, principals and glossary terms whose names, labels or descriptions, a table's declared grain, the label or description of a column's declared measure, or a term's synonyms or definition contain `q` (1 to 200 characters, case-insensitive; run ids need four characters or more), one page at a time. Texts in a table's main language always match; translated texts match in your languages (`lang`, else your profile's language, else `Accept-Language`, else the instance's main language), and each hit says which language matched. A table or column a term links is also found by the term's name and synonyms, with `matched: term` and the term's key in `term`. A table, column or term is one hit, however many of its texts match. What the caller may not read is left out of the hits, not refused: tables and columns need `READ_TABLE`, runs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`, principals the right to list them. Glossary terms need `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. A table or column found by a term's name or synonym (`matched: term`) needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT` and the table's `READ_TABLE`. Needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers 404 when the environment does not exist and 422 for a `q`, `model_kind`, `lang` or paging value out of range.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `q` | query | yes | text | The text to find; 1 to 200 characters, case-insensitive. |
| `kind` | query | no | `SearchKind` or null | Only this kind of hit. |
| `model_kind` | query | no | text or null | Only tables whose asset header declares this kind: fact, dimension, wide or staging. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Hits per page, 1 to 100. |
| `offset` | query | no | whole number | Hits to skip. |
| `lang` | query | no | text or null | The language of the texts, such as de or fr-CH; without it, your profile's language, then Accept-Language, then the instance's main language. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `SearchOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `SearchOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `results` | list of `SearchHitOut` | yes |  |
| `limit` | whole number | yes |  |
| `offset` | whole number | yes |  |
| `has_more` | true or false | yes |  |
